29172.d: Warforge Dig Site is a dig site that players can visit when they reach level 76 Archaeology.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Archaeology teleport, purchased for 250 chronotes from Ezreal at the Archaeology Guild Shop
• Archaeology journal, teleport to the Archaeology Campus then running west, inside the main building, and use the dig sites map table inside to teleport to it directly
• Master archaeologist's outfit teleport function
• Spirit tree teleport to South Feldip Hills
• Rub a ring of duelling to "Warforge"
• Teleport to the Oo'glog lodestone and run far west

29210.d: The Warriors' Guild is a guild for warriors located in west Burthorpe.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The Warriors' Guild is located in Burthorpe and can be accessed in a number of ways:
• Burthorpe lodestone, which will teleport players directly east of the guild.
• Combat bracelet, which will teleport players to a location directly outside the guild.
• Games necklace, which will teleport players to Troll Invasion, just north of the guild.
